title: Eagles say Jaguars made an offer they couldn't refuse for Jordan Davis

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles say Jaguars made an offer they couldn't refuse for Jordan Davis
sources.description: The Eagles announced the trade that sent defensive tackle Jordan Davis to the Jaguars, saying the "Jaguars made an offer that executive vice president/General Manager Howie Roseman simply could not refuse."
